captions: So far, individuals. Now the institutional mind — a
man who turned a repeatable process into a fund

Sunil Singhania is a chartered financial analyst who
founded
Abakkus Asset Management in twenty eighteen.

His personal disclosed book — around twenty-four
stocks, worth
roughly two thousand three hundred crore — is only
the visible tip; he manages far more for others.
What sets him apart isn't a hot tip. It's

a framework: durable earnings, sane valuations,
trustworthy management —

applied the same way, every time, across capital
goods,

The amateur chases the next big thing. The
professional
builds a process that survives being wrong — because

over enough decisions, repeatability beats
brilliance.

That's the quiet superpower the finfluencers can
never sell
you, because you can't fake a process.
